Why Eating Less Might Be Slowing Your Weight Loss

If you’ve been trying to lose weight by simply eating less but feel like your body is resisting, you’re not imagining it. The human body is designed to adapt, especially when it senses restriction. This process is known as metabolic adaptation.
When calorie intake remains too low for too long, the body becomes more efficient at using less energy. It starts conserving rather than burning calories. This means fewer calories are used at rest, during movement, and even for digestion.

It's this phrase that  made me decide to  contact a Nutritional & Dietician .
''Good GUT Health is as important as a Healthy Heart .
That's how I met Geetanjali Chitale of 'CULTIWEIGHT' at Vile Parle east Mumbai.

Geetanjali 's  diet plan is very simple, No protein powders & energy bars ! A well planned homely wholesome diet, right quantity, at the right time. And the most important thing is the written homework on a  daily basis, about what U eat does plays a major role.
Strict & very vigilant like a  monitor who   highlights what we should not eat to safe guard one's health, keeps a check on what we eat.
Concerned about her Patient 's health is  Dr Geetanjali's way of getting U back to a healthy body. After all ''Health is Wealth''.

Thank U Geetanjali Chitale & so My  journey..... Continues with Cultiweight!
